release.rights: No redistribution licence identified. This pilot is a small selected factual extract, not a copy of the dataset.

indicator.definition: Number of mainline telephone lines connecting customer equipment to the public switched telephone network at year end.
indicator.upstream_attribution: Mitchell (1998) and World Bank (2007), as listed by Comin and Hobijn.

selection_rule: Exactly Japan, Kenya and United Kingdom, each in 1950, 1980 and 2000; preserve missing cells.
scope: Country-year series values from the named CHAT release, using its original country labels and definitions.
cautions: Lines are not people, households, ownership, access rights, or an adoption percentage.
Source definitions and historical geographic boundaries may differ; CHAT describes some merged and backward-extrapolated series.
Blank means unknown, never zero. No denominator or discovery mapping is inferred.
